hits.snippet: # G2 Acquires Software Advice ... Acquired by ... UndisclosedJan 29, 2026 ... On January 29, 2026, G2, based in Chicago, acquired Software Advice in a business acquisition for an undisclosed amount. This deal unites two significant players in the business software review and comparison space. G2, founded in 2012, operates a freemium platform leveraging peer reviews to disrupt traditional B2B software evaluation. Software Advice, established in 2005, provides advisory services, research, and user reviews across over 300 software market categories. Previously acquired by Gartner in 2014, Software Advice connects businesses with software vendors, generating revenue through vendor partnerships.

hits.title: G2 Acquires Gartner Digital Markets Division · Discoperi M&A Intelligence
hits.snippet: G2's acquisition of Gartner Digital Markets' division for $110 million represents a strategic move to enhance its software review capabilities within the technology sector. This carve-out transaction allows G2 to streamline operations and focus on its core business areas, particularly in leveraging Capterra, GetApp, and Software Advice to expand its market reach and user base. The deal fills a gap in G2's portfolio by integrating robust software evaluation tools that complement its existing services, thereby strengthening its competitive position. The transaction mechanics are straightforward but nuanced. Structured as an all-cash sale subject to customary purchase price adjustments, the exact final figure remains contingent on post-closing reconciliations of balance sheet items such as working capital. The $110 million valuation provides a headline number that may fluctuate based on these adjustments, reflecting the business's actual financial condition at closing. This acquisition shifts competitive dynamics in the software review space, enhancing G2’s market share and positioning against rivals like TrustRadius and SoftwareReviews. hits.title: software-marketplace-landscape
hits.snippet: Cross-checking software reviews across multiple sites used to mean opening three browser tabs and assuming three different editorial teams. That assumption broke this year. After G2’s acquisition of Capterra, GetApp, and Software Advice from Gartner, one company now sets the review policy, the placement rules, and the data pipeline behind four of the five most-visited software review destinations on the internet. The fifth, Gartner Peer Insights, stayed inside Gartner. TrustRadius sits under HG Insights. SourceForge and Slashdot sit under Slashdot Media. Crozdesk’s vendor-facing lead product, now called RevLeads, sits under Black & White Zebra.
